description: Two-tier affiliate match config (C2.5.4). strong = the program's own name or an explicit alias; weak = generic category/feature/use-case terms. Own-name matching is derived from the program name (no per-term data). Only add an alias where the name cannot derive it (audited: HubSpot katakana, Make domain). ambiguous_brands lists own-name tokens that are ordinary words: they are strong only with a brand form (monday.com), a Japanese-language context, or an explicit alias. without_context is the explicit treatment of a bare/English-only use ('make', 'make money'). reviewed_distinctive_brands records the catalog own-name tokens reviewed as distinctive (C2.5.2/C2.5.3 audit of all 19 programs).

fireflies.reason: an ordinary English noun; bare 'fireflies' is kept weak by decision (revisit only with SERP/GSC evidence)

notion.reason: an ordinary English noun (program is paused)

jasper.reason: a common given name (program status is unknown)
